title: Detect Duplicate Subtrees
problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree, identify all distinct subtrees that appear more than once. Two subtrees are considered duplicates if they have identical structure and node values.
input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
output: • Print the root values of all duplicate subtrees in the required order. If no duplicate subtree exists, print NONE.
